source_use: Functional NTFS facts only; independent implementation and generated images. No fetched source is compiled or executed.
facts: The list descriptor belongs to the base FILE; its resident or nonresident value describes other attribute extents. The list itself is not enumerated by its own entries in the inspected NTFS-3G lookup.

The inspected kernel loads a nonresident list only from a VCN0 descriptor, decodes its run mapping and reads its exact declared data value. A bounded profile must report larger values/closures explicitly rather than invent a contiguous layout.
Only first extents provide authoritative stream sizes; retain the previous byte-granular initialized-size reconciliation instead of imposing cluster rounding from older documentation.

Missing full references are dependency facts. Source reads require already validated MFT coverage, exact generation/reference matching, retained byte provenance and rereads; no contiguous-index guess or stale-reference retry.
